correctness.rationale: The estimator error identity, exact endpoint cgf supremum, reflection-convexity midpoint argument, explicit rare-propensity envelope, Chernoff inversion, Hoeffding comparison, Bernstein radius, and endpoint triangular-array CLT were checked analytically, including equal- and heterogeneous-propensity special cases.

originality.rationale: Current randomization-inference work gives heterogeneous Hoeffding bounds and common-propensity sharper bounds, while recent midpoint-differenced Horvitz--Thompson minimax theory concerns squared error. No prior source was located stating the combined exact heterogeneous endpoint cgf, pointwise midpoint cgf minimaxity, and resulting aggregate effective-sample-size consequence. Residual survey-sampling literature risk is documented in REVIEW.md.

value.rationale: The result gives a computable finite-sample design-based interval for arbitrary independent propensities, strictly refines the support-length Hoeffding certificate, identifies a heterogeneous effective-sample-size scale, and supplies a matching asymptotic rate obstruction for midpoint-centered fixed-radius intervals.
